transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started on the maintenance board for the next workday. We've got four work orders to schedule: vehicle V-17, generator G-2, communications shelter UPS-3, and support vehicle CH-4. The workday runs 0800 to 1600, and each item needs a scheduled window and a responsible section assigned. Available sections are Motor Pool, Power Section, Signal Shop, and Support Equipment Cell. Before I sign the board, I need each section to confirm their updates during this huddle. Let's work through these one at a time. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: Major, before we go further on V-17, I need to put this on the table. It must be scheduled from 0800 to 1000 under Motor Pool control, and the dispatch hold stays in place until the verification is signed. The result is sitting in the motor-pool inspection folder right now but hasn't been copied to the battalion board yet.
